description: Central Province - Amendments to the Sinhala text of the By-Laws relating to Parking Hiring Cars and Motor Vechicles and High Roads and Byroads of Ganga Ihala Korale P.S published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1877/32 of 28.08.2014
categorisation: The gazette content announces the approval and amendment of by-laws (parking regulations and road regulations) for a local government body (Ganga Ihala Korale Pradeshiya Sabha). This involves the creation and modification of local regulatory frameworks, which falls under the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) for "subsidiary legislation" and "regulatory frameworks." While a government official (Sarath Ekanayake) is named, the primary purpose is to enact legal instruments, not to detail his personal portfolio responsibilities or make a personnel announcement. Therefore, the specialized legal/regulatory classification takes precedence.
